title: Account
daysLeft: {count, plural, =0 {final day} one {day left} other {days left}}
trialUpgrade: Subscribe now — the paid period starts right after the trial day, so you keep the time that is left.
noPaymentMethod: No card on file — auto-renewal is off
bindCard: Add a card and turn on auto-renewal
extraDevicesCount: {limit, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}} on the subscription
extraDevicesHint: An extra device place costs {price} ₽ and lasts as long as the subscription.
extraDevicesResult: After this purchase — {total, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}}
extraDevicesMaxed: Maximum of {limit, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}} reached — no more can be added.
pitch: Access to every country, cancel in one click

plans.renewalNote: Your payment method will be saved, and auto-renewal will charge {price} ₽ {plan, select, monthly {every month} halfYearly {every six months} other {every year}} — the plan’s full price, as discounts do not apply to it. YooKassa says so on the payment page. You can turn auto-renewal off right here in one click.
plans.discountNote: Your {percent}% discount is already in the price
plans.discountHint: Promo code {code}. The discount applies to this one payment — renewals are at the regular price.

profile.title: Profile
profile.emailChangeHint: We will send a link to your current address — the change applies once confirmed.
profile.emailChangeRequested: If the address is free, the confirmation is already in your current inbox.
profile.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Other devices will be signed out.
profile.addEmailHint: Right now Telegram is the only way into this account. Add an email, then set a password below — that gives you a second way in.
profile.emailAdded: If the address is free, the email is on its way. Nothing arrived? It may already belong to an account.
profile.setPasswordHint: No password yet — this account was created through Telegram. We will email you a link to set one.
profile.setPasswordNeedsEmail: Add an email above first — there is nowhere to send the link.
profile.passwordLinkSent: The link is on its way to your inbox

danger.title: Delete account
danger.body: Your subscription, devices and link stop working immediately. This cannot be undone. If you want a refund for the unused period, write to us before deleting.
danger.confirmBody: The subscription ends at once, every device disconnects and the link stops working. We cannot bring the account back. A refund for the unused period has to be requested before deleting — afterwards we cannot match your payment.

unavailable: Could not load the subscription status. Check your connection and try again.
unbindConfirmBody: Auto-renewal stops with it: when the paid period ends, access ends too unless you pay again by hand. You can add a card again at any time.

connect.label: How to connect

link.title: With a link
link.hint: One subscription — every country and protocol. The server list updates by itself.

config.title: With a config
config.hint: A WireGuard file for one device and one country — for routers and WireGuard apps.

connect.wireguardLocked: WireGuard configs appear once a free day or a subscription is active. <link>Go to Subscription</link>
connect.noAccess: Until a free day or a subscription is active, the link below delivers no servers — the app will show an empty list. <link>Go to Subscription</link>
connect.unavailable: Could not check the subscription status. Check your connection and try again.

renew.title: Extend your subscription
renew.hint: Pick a term — it is added to the current one, so the days you have left are kept. You can pick a different term, not only the current one.
renew.soon: {count, plural, =0 {Your subscription ends today} one {Your subscription ends in # day} other {Your subscription ends in # days}} — extend it now so the VPN does not stop.
renew.chargeFailed: The last automatic charge failed — extend your subscription manually.

pending.title: Waiting for YooKassa to confirm the payment
pending.body: It usually takes under a minute. Please do not pay twice — the subscription updates here on its own.
pending.settled: Payment received — your subscription is updated
pending.cancelled: The payment was cancelled — nothing was charged. You can pay again.

support.title: Need help?
support.body: Cannot connect, a payment did not go through or you want a refund — write to us, we answer within a day.

marketing.label: Send me discounts and offers
marketing.hint: Now and then, by email and in the Telegram bot. Reminders about payments and your subscription ending arrive either way.
marketing.unavailable: Could not load this setting. Check your connection and try again.
marketing.promptBody: By email and in the bot — only when there is something worth offering. You can change your mind in the profile.
